results.title: Smooth Recorder:   Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop | Product Hunt
results.content:
Aleksandar Blazhev

Excited to hunt Smooth Recorder today.

Lately, I’ve been making more tutorials, so I’ve tried quite a few screen recording tools on Mac, including Screen Studio. Smooth Recorder genuinely holds its own against them and in a few areas, I actually prefer it.

What stands out:

• Automatic zooms + smooth cursor: Recordings already look edited when you hit stop.  
• Transcript editing: Edit the video by editing the text, and remove filler words or long pauses in one click.  
• More than video: Screenshots, scrolling captures, GIFs, text extraction, and smart redaction are all built in.  
• Native + private: It’s a real macOS app, and captions, OCR, and redaction all happen locally on your Mac. [...] Smooth Recorder

results.title: Smooth Capture: 3D device frame screen recording for macOS | Product Hunt
results.content:
Alexey Glukharev

Congrats on the launch, Vu! 🎉 This is exactly the tool I’ve been looking for — building OceanMind, a premium iOS breathwork app, and the demo video phase is always the most painful part. The 3D device frames with iPhone/iPad USB recording is a killer combo. Loved that it’s native Swift + Metal too, that matters. The AI editing roadmap for Q2 is what really caught my eye — filler word removal and edit-by-transcript would be a game changer for solo indie devs doing everything themselves. Rooting for this one!

Vu Nguyen
